title: Treehouse 1st floor, walkout to hot tub nature
description:
Reconnect with nature at this unforgettable escape. Walk out your room to several hiking trails. Room has a queen, a single, and a hammock. It shares a full bathroom with the upstairs unit, but your lodging is very private.
No full kitchen. But yes, microwave and induction stove. Hot tub is just out the door ($50 add’l fee for cleaning and setup). Slow hotspot internet. Good phone reception once you get down the driveway.  NO PARTIES; NO EVENTS

The space
This converted barn has two floors, with a shared full bathroom between the two floors. When you are using the bathroom, you can lock a door so the second floor cannot access the half-floor containing the bathroom and laundry room. This makes it very safe in case you do not wish to see anybody else but those in your party.

We are honored to be Stewards of Big East Fork Valley and support the nearby Center for Sustainable Stewardship. We enjoy the abundant wildlife and the many nearby creeks and hiking trails.
